values.name: All open
values.jql: project = SANDBOX AND resolution = Unresolved ORDER BY "Time to resolution" ASC

values.name: Assigned to me
values.jql: project = SANDBOX AND assignee = currentUser() AND resolution = Unresolved ORDER BY created DESC

values.name: Incidents
values.jql: project = SANDBOX AND issuetype = Incident AND resolution = Unresolved ORDER BY "Time to resolution" ASC

values.name: Service requests
values.jql: project = SANDBOX AND issuetype = "Service request" AND resolution = Unresolved ORDER BY created DESC

values.name: Problems
values.jql: project = SANDBOX AND issuetype = Problem AND resolution = Unresolved ORDER BY created DESC
